name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix + battle domain + descriptive role. '12color' is a real domain dimension (12-entry color-rotation cycle, color_idx 0..11), not a Ghidra address residue. 'v_offset_table' reflects the vertical-offset semantics and the array data type. No hex address suffix. Keep.
purpose: Read-only per-color vertical lift (row-stride multiplier) for the 12-sprite main summon-spell (召喚系) animation; one of three sibling per-color tables consumed by the main-animation state machine.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_tick_summon_spell_main_animation_state (@ 0x26795; dispatch-table entry +3 of the 10-entry summon tick table @ 0x523B9) copies the 12 bytes into a stack-local (Ghidra renders the copy as 3 dwords = var_20 region) then byte-indexes by the slot's current color_idx (0..11). Used in the blit y formula: screen_y = (origin_y + y_offset[color]) - v_offset[color] * row_stride. Sibling of the y-offset table @ 0x52460 and the sprite-offset table @ 0x5249C.
element_semantics: Each element [color 0..11] is a small unsigned count of framebuffer rows: the per-color vertical lift, multiplied by row_stride and subtracted from the slot's base y. Values = {0,10,0,20,5,20,0,10,0,18,0,10}.
notes: Verified byte-identical: Ghidra symbol name == src name == data_fd2_battle_summon_main_anim_12color_v_offset_table; Ghidra type byte[12] == src uint8[12]; memory @0x52490 = 00 0a 00 14 05 14 00 0a 00 12 00 0a == src {0,10,0,20,5,20,0,10,0,18,0,10}. const confirmed: both xrefs (READ @0x267c9, DATA @0x267c4) isWrite=false, zero game-side writers. src comment (btltab2.c lines 42-54) is precise, ASCII, 流水帳-free and matches the decompiled blit formula -> comment_verdict=keep, no Edit made. Ghidra plate lives in PRE_COMMENT (not PLATE_COMMENT) and is consistent with the refined understanding (content, reader, formula all correct) -> ghidra_plate_action=none (rule: only update plate when it contradicts/is outdated/blank). Cosmetic naming nit (NOT actioned, out of scope for this single symbol): the sibling y-offset table @0x52460 is named '...12slot_y_offset_table' yet it too is indexed by color_idx like this '12color' table; the slot-vs-color wording is inconsistent between siblings but both terms are defensible (12 slots each carrying a color index 0..11) and neither is wrong; no rename proposed.
